caption: Saint James Church on the main street, bell-cote standing proud above the three lancet windows. A lovely calm centrepiece in the heart of the village (May 2026)
The corner of the church and the cast-iron downpipe we're hoping to feed into a water butt. Conversation underway with Father Tom about adding rainwater harvesting (May 2026)

Our bug hotel in the church grounds, mounted on a recycled tree stump and packed with pine cones, bamboo, drilled timber and reeds. Five-star accommodation for solitary bees, ladybirds and lacewings (May 2026)

The big deep clean of Saint James Church back in late 2023, with a Genie cherry-picker reaching right up to the bell-cote and gable. You can see the contrast between the freshly cleaned section and the older grime above the windows. Father Tom organised the works and we were delighted to chip in (December 2023)
